statement: The maximum liability of the Government inserted in the Limitation of Government Liability clause shall be the estimated amount necessary to cover the contractor's requirements for funds before definitization.
quote: The maximum liability of the Government inserted in the clause at 52.216-24, Limitation of Government Liability, shall be the estimated amount necessary to cover the contractor's requirements for funds before definitization.

statement: FAR 52.216-5 is a clause on prospective price redetermination that is inserted in contracts as prescribed in FAR 16.205-4.
quote: 52.216-5 Price Redetermination—Prospective. As prescribed in 16.205-4, insert the following clause:

statement: Under the clause, prices are periodically redetermined, subject to listed exceptions that include prices for supplies delivered and services performed before the first effective date of price redetermination, which remain fixed.
quote: unit prices and the total price stated in this contract shall be periodically redetermined in accordance with this clause, except that (1) the prices for supplies delivered and services performed before the first effective date of price redetermination (see paragraph (c) below) shall remain fixed

statement: The first period runs from the contract date to a stated point and each later period runs for a stated number of months from the end of the last, except that the parties may agree to vary the length of the final period.
quote: The first period shall extend from the date of the contract to __, [see Note (1)] and the second and each succeeding period shall extend for __ [insert appropriate number] months from the end of the last preceding period, except that the parties may agree to vary the length of the final period.

statement: The contractor submits its data within a window set by a stated maximum and a stated minimum number of days before the end of each redetermination period except the last.
quote: Not more than __ nor less than __ [see Note (2)] days before the end of each redetermination period, except the last, the Contractor shall submit—

statement: One listed submission is proposed prices for supplies that may be delivered or services that may be performed in the next succeeding period, with an estimate and breakdown of their costs in the Table 15-2 format of FAR 15.408 or another form the parties agree.
quote: Proposed prices for supplies that may be delivered or services that may be performed in the next succeeding period, and— (A) An estimate and breakdown of the costs of these supplies or services in the format of Table 15-2, FAR 15.408, or in any other form on which the parties may agree;

statement: Two further listed items that accompany the cost estimate are sufficient data to support its accuracy and reliability and an explanation of its differences from the original or last preceding estimate.
quote: (B) Sufficient data to support the accuracy and reliability of this estimate; and (C) An explanation of the differences between this estimate and the original (or last preceding) estimate for the same supplies or services; and

statement: One listed submission is a statement of all costs incurred in performing the contract through the end of a stated month before the proposed prices are submitted.
quote: A statement of all costs incurred in performing this contract through the end of the ___ month (see Note (3)) before the submission of proposed prices

statement: If the contractor fails to submit the required data within the time specified, the contracting officer may suspend payments under the contract until the data are furnished.
quote: If the Contractor fails to submit the data required by subparagraphs (1) and (2) above, within the time specified, the Contracting Officer may suspend payments under this contract until the data are furnished.

statement: If the parties fail to agree upon redetermined prices within 60 days, or another agreed period, after the date the data are to be submitted, the contracting officer shall promptly issue a decision.
quote: fail to agree upon redetermined prices for any price redetermination period within 60 days (or within such other period as the parties agree) after the date on which the data required by paragraph (d) above are to be submitted, the Contracting Officer shall promptly issue a decision

statement: FAR 52.216-16 is a clause on incentive price revision with a firm target that is inserted in contracts as prescribed in FAR 16.406(a).
quote: 52.216-16 Incentive Price Revision—Firm Target. As prescribed in 16.406(a), insert the following clause:

statement: The clause makes the Schedule items it identifies subject to price revision, provided that in no event may their total final price exceed the stated ceiling price.
quote: are subject to price revision in accordance with this clause; provided, that in no event shall the total final price of these items exceed the ceiling price of ___ dollars ($___).

statement: The contractor submits its data within a number of days set by the contracting officer after the end of the month in which it delivered the last unit of supplies and completed the services for the items.
quote: Within __ [Contracting Officer insert number of days] days after the end of the month in which the Contractor has delivered the last unit of supplies and completed the services specified by item number in paragraph (a) of this clause, the Contractor shall submit

quote: (i) A detailed statement of all costs incurred up to the end of that month in performing all work under the items; (ii) An estimate of costs of further performance, if any, that may be necessary to complete performance of all work under the items;

statement: The total final price is established by applying to the total final negotiated cost an adjustment for profit or loss, and the adjustment equals the total target profit when total final negotiated cost equals total target cost.
quote: The total final price shall be established by applying to the total final negotiated cost an adjustment for profit or loss, as follows: (i) If the total final negotiated cost is equal to the total target cost, the adjustment is the total target profit.

statement: One listed case is that, when total final negotiated cost is greater than total target cost, the adjustment is the total target profit less a stated percent of the amount of the overrun.
quote: If the total final negotiated cost is greater than the total target cost, the adjustment is the total target profit, less ___ [Contracting Officer insert percent] percent of the amount by which the total final negotiated cost exceeds the total target cost.

statement: One listed case is that, when final negotiated cost is less than total target cost, the adjustment is the total target profit plus a stated percent of the amount of the underrun.
quote: If the final negotiated cost is less than the total target cost, the adjustment is the total target profit plus ___ [Contracting Officer insert percent] percent of the amount by which the total final negotiated cost is less than the total target cost.

statement: Pending the modification that sets the total final price, the contractor invoices at billing prices, and the billing prices are the target prices shown in the contract.
quote: Pending execution of the contract modification (see paragraph (e) above), the Contractor shall submit invoices or vouchers in accordance with billing prices as provided in this paragraph. The billing prices shall be the target prices shown in this contract.

statement: If it appears from the contractor's information that billing prices will be substantially greater than estimated final prices, the parties shall negotiate a reduction in billing prices.
quote: If at any time it appears from information provided by the contractor under subparagraph (g)(2) below that the then-current billing prices will be substantially greater than the estimated final prices, the parties shall negotiate a reduction in the billing prices.

statement: The parties may negotiate an increase in billing prices by any or all of the difference between target prices and the ceiling price, on the contractor's factual data showing that final cost will be substantially greater than target cost.
quote: Similarly, the parties may negotiate an increase in billing prices by any or all of the difference between the target prices and the ceiling price, upon the Contractor's submission of factual data showing that final cost under this contract will be substantially greater than the target cost.

statement: FAR 52.216-17 is a clause on incentive price revision with successive targets that is inserted in contracts as prescribed in FAR 16.406(b).
quote: 52.216-17 Incentive Price Revision—Successive Targets. As prescribed in 16.406(b), insert the following clause:

statement: The contracting officer and the contractor shall promptly establish either a firm fixed price or a profit adjustment formula for determining final profit, and the parties shall negotiate a total firm target cost based upon the data submitted under paragraph (c).
quote: the Contracting Officer and the Contractor shall promptly establish either a firm fixed price or a profit adjustment formula for determining final profit, as follows: (1) The parties shall negotiate a total firm target cost, based upon the data submitted under paragraph (c) above.

statement: Total initial target profit is decreased if total firm target cost is more than total initial target cost, and increased if total firm target cost is less.
quote: If the total firm target cost is more than the total initial target cost, the total initial target profit shall be decreased. If the total firm target cost is less than the total initial target cost, the total initial target profit shall be increased.

statement: The total firm target profit may in no event be less than one stated percent or more than another stated percent of the total initial target cost.
quote: provided, that in no event shall the total firm target profit be less than __ percent or more than __ percent [Contracting Officer insert percents] of the total initial target cost.

statement: If total firm target cost plus total firm target profit represent a reasonable price for the part of the contract subject to price revision, the parties may agree on a firm fixed price.
quote: If the total firm target cost plus the total firm target profit represent a reasonable price for performing that part of the contract subject to price revision under this clause, the parties may agree on a firm fixed price

statement: A failure to agree to a firm fixed price is not a dispute under the Disputes clause, and if agreement is not reached or a firm fixed price is inappropriate the parties shall establish a profit adjustment formula.
quote: Failure of the parties to agree to a firm fixed price shall not constitute a dispute under the Disputes clause. If agreement is not reached, or if establishment of a firm fixed price is inappropriate, the Contractor and the Contracting Officer shall establish a profit adjustment formula

statement: One listed case of the profit adjustment formula is that, when total final negotiated cost is greater than total firm target cost, the adjustment is the total firm target profit less a stated percent of the overrun.
quote: If the total final negotiated cost is greater than the total firm target cost, the adjustment is the total firm target profit, less __ percent of the amount by which the total final negotiated cost exceeds the total firm target cost.

statement: One listed case of the profit adjustment formula is that, when total final negotiated cost is less than total firm target cost, the adjustment is the total firm target profit plus a stated percent of the underrun.
quote: If the total final negotiated cost is less than the total firm target cost, the adjustment is the total firm target profit, plus __ percent of the amount by which the total final negotiated cost is less than the total firm target cost.

statement: Under the Order Limitations clause, when the Government requires covered supplies or services in an amount of less than a stated figure, neither the Government nor the contractor is obligated to buy or furnish them under the contract.
quote: (a) Minimum order. When the Government requires supplies or services covered by this contract in an amount of less than ___ [insert dollar figure or quantity], the Government is not obligated to purchase, nor is the Contractor obligated to furnish, those supplies or services under the contract.

statement: Under the Order Limitations clause, the contractor is not obligated to honor an order for a single item, or for a combination of items, in excess of the stated dollar figure or quantity.
quote: (b) Maximum order. The Contractor is not obligated to honor— (1) Any order for a single item in excess of ___ [insert dollar figure or quantity]; (2) Any order for a combination of items in excess of ___ [insert dollar figure or quantity];

statement: The contractor shall honor an order over the maximum order limits unless it is returned to the ordering office within a stated number of days after issuance with written notice of its intent not to ship and the reasons.
quote: Contractor shall honor any order exceeding the maximum order limitations in paragraph (b), unless that order (or orders) is returned to the ordering office within __ days after issuance, with written notice stating the Contractor's intent not to ship the item (or items) called for and the reasons.

statement: Under the Indefinite Quantity clause, the contract is effective for the period stated in the Schedule, and the Schedule quantities are estimates only and are not purchased by the contract.
quote: (a) This is an indefinite-quantity contract for the supplies or services specified, and effective for the period stated, in the Schedule. The quantities of supplies and services specified in the Schedule are estimates only and are not purchased by this contract.

statement: Supplies or services are to be furnished when and if ordered up to the Schedule maximum, and the Government shall order at least the Schedule minimum.
quote: when and if ordered, the supplies or services specified in the Schedule up to and including the quantity designated in the Schedule as the maximum. The Government shall order at least the quantity of supplies or services designated in the Schedule as the minimum.

statement: An order issued during the effective period and not completed within that period shall be completed by the contractor within the time specified in the order.
quote: Any order issued during the effective period of this contract and not completed within that period shall be completed by the Contractor within the time specified in the order.

statement: FAR 52.216-29 is the provision titled Time-and-Materials/Labor-Hour Proposal Requirements—Other Than Commercial Acquisition With Adequate Price Competition, inserted as prescribed in FAR 16.601(f)(1).
quote: 52.216-29 Time-and-Materials/Labor-Hour Proposal Requirements—Other Than Commercial Acquisition With Adequate Price Competition. As prescribed in 16.601(f)(1), insert the following provision:

quote: 52.216-30 Time-and-Materials/Labor-Hour Proposal Requirements—Other Than Commercial Acquisition Without Adequate Price Competition. As prescribed in 16.601(f)(2), insert the following provision:

quote: The Contracting Officer shall release 75 percent of all fee withholds under this contract after receipt of an adequate certified final indirect cost rate proposal covering the year of physical completion of this contract, provided the Contractor has satisfied all other contract terms and conditions

statement: In the basic clause, any proposal for negotiating prices for items of supplies shall distribute costs within contracts on a basis that ensures that unit prices are in proportion to the items' base cost.

quote: Any method of distributing costs to line items that distorts unit prices shall not be used. For example, distributing costs equally among line items is not acceptable except when there is little or no variation in base cost.

statement: The clause's cost-distribution paragraph does not require submission of certified cost or pricing data that is not otherwise required by law or regulation.
quote: Nothing in this paragraph requires submission of certified cost or pricing data not otherwise required by law or regulation.

statement: In the basic clause, when requested by the contracting officer, the offeror or contractor shall also identify the supplies that it will not manufacture or to which it will not contribute significant value.
quote: When requested by the Contracting Officer, the Offeror/Contractor shall also identify those supplies that it will not manufacture or to which it will not contribute significant value.

statement: Whenever there is uncompensated overtime, the adjusted hourly rate including uncompensated overtime, rather than the hourly rate, shall be applied to all proposed hours, whether regular or overtime.

quote: (2) in no event shall the total amount paid under this contract exceed any ceiling price included in the contract.

quote: For the purpose of paragraphs (f), (g), and (h) above, and pending final settlement of the disagreement on appeal, by failure to appeal, or by agreement, this decision shall be treated as an executed contract modification.

statement: The listed data items also include a list of all residual inventory and an estimate of its value, and any other relevant data that the contracting officer may reasonably require.

quote: (i) If the total final negotiated cost is equal to the total firm target cost, the adjustment is the total firm target profit.

statement: If a rated order is placed for the purpose of emergency preparedness requirements and expedited action is necessary or appropriate to meet these requirements, a prescribed statement must be included in the order.
quote: (b) Additional element required for certain emergency preparedness rated orders. If a rated order is placed for the purpose of emergency preparedness requirements and expedited action is necessary or appropriate to meet these requirements, the following statement must be included in the order:
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.12(b).

statement: Contracting officers shall insert the provision Notice of Priority Rating for National Defense, Emergency Preparedness, and Energy Program Use in solicitations when the contract to be awarded will be a rated order.
quote: (a) Contracting officers shall insert the provision at 52.211-14, Notice of Priority Rating for National Defense, Emergency Preparedness, and Energy Program Use, in solicitations when the contract to be awarded will be a rated order.

statement: Contracting officers shall insert the clause Defense Priority and Allocation Requirements in contracts that are rated orders.
quote: (b) Contracting officers shall insert the clause at 52.211-15, Defense Priority and Allocation Requirements, in contracts that are rated orders.

statement: Rated orders shall be placed in accordance with the provisions of the DPAS, and agency heads shall ensure compliance with the DPAS by contracting activities within their agencies.
quote: (c) Rated orders shall be placed in accordance with the provisions of the DPAS. (d) Agency heads shall ensure compliance with the DPAS by contracting activities within their agencies.

statement: Except as otherwise specified in the section, a person shall accept every rated order received and must fill such orders regardless of any other rated or unrated orders that have been accepted.
quote: (a) Mandatory acceptance. (1) Except as otherwise specified in this section, a person shall accept every rated order received and must fill such orders regardless of any other rated or unrated orders that have been accepted.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(a)(1). The printed text does not define person.

statement: Unless otherwise directed by Commerce, a person shall not accept a rated order for delivery on a specific date if unable to fill the order by that date, but must inform the customer of the earliest date on which delivery can be made and offer to accept the order.
quote: Unless otherwise directed by Commerce: (1) A person shall not accept a rated order for delivery on a specific date if unable to fill the order by that date. However, the person must inform the customer of the earliest date on which delivery can be made and offer to accept the order
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(b)(1).

statement: Unless otherwise directed by Commerce, rated orders may be rejected in the listed cases as long as a supplier does not discriminate among customers, including when the person placing the order is unwilling or unable to meet regularly established terms of sale or payment.
quote: (c) Optional rejection. Unless otherwise directed by Commerce, rated orders may be rejected in any of the following cases as long as a supplier does not discriminate among customers: (1) If the person placing the order is unwilling or unable to meet regularly established terms of sale or payment;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(c) and (c)(1).

statement: Except as provided in paragraph (d)(2) of that section, a person must accept or reject a rated order in writing or in electronic format within fifteen (15) working days after receipt of a DO rated order and within ten (10) working days after receipt of a DX rated order.
quote: Except as provided in paragraph (d)(2) of this section, a person must accept or reject a rated order in writing (hard copy), or in electronic format, within fifteen (15) working days after receipt of a DO rated order and within ten (10) working days after receipt of a DX rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(d)(1).

statement: 15 CFR 700.13(d)(2) gives six (6) hours after receipt as one minimum time for acceptance or rejection that such orders may specify, where the order is issued by an authorized person in response to a hazard that has occurred.
quote: The minimum times for acceptance or rejection that such orders may specify are six (6) hours after receipt of the order if the order is issued by an authorized person in response to a hazard that has occurred,
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(d)(2); the twelve-hour minimum is in the next claim and the lead-in is a separate claim.

statement: In 15 CFR 700.13(d)(2), twelve (12) hours after receipt applies if the order is issued by an authorized person to prepare for an imminent hazard.
quote: or twelve (12) hours after receipt if the order is issued by an authorized person to prepare for an imminent hazard.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(d)(2).

statement: DO rated orders must be given production preference over unrated orders, if necessary to meet required delivery dates, even if this requires the diversion of items being processed or ready for delivery against unrated orders, and DX rated orders must likewise be given preference over DO rated orders.
quote: DO rated orders must be given production preference over unrated orders, if necessary to meet required delivery dates, even if this requires the diversion of items being processed or ready for delivery against unrated orders. Similarly, DX rated orders must be given preference over DO rated orders
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.14(b).

statement: The required elements of a rated order must be included on each successive order placed to obtain industrial resources needed to fill a customer's rated order.
quote: (b) The required elements of a rated order outlined in § 700.12 must be included on each successive order placed to obtain industrial resources needed to fill a customer's rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.15(b).

statement: In determining cancellation ceilings, the contracting officer must estimate reasonable preproduction or startup, labor learning, and other nonrecurring costs to be incurred by an average prime contractor or subcontractor.
quote: In determining cancellation ceilings, the contracting officer must estimate reasonable preproduction or startup, labor learning, and other nonrecurring costs to be incurred by an “average” prime contractor or subcontractor

statement: FAR 17.108(b) provides that the contract may not be awarded until the thirty-first day after the date of notification.
quote: The contract may not be awarded until the thirty-first day after the date of notification.
note: The same sentence ends paragraph (a) for the other agencies; the scope here comes from the paragraph (b) claim.

statement: FAR 17.106-3 is headed Special procedures applicable to DoD, NASA, and the Coast Guard.
quote: 17.106-3 Special procedures applicable to DoD, NASA, and the Coast Guard.
note: The scope of paragraphs (d) and (e) comes from this section heading.

statement: FAR 9.305 provides that, to minimize this risk, the contracting officer shall provide sufficient time in the delivery schedule for acquisition of materials and components, and for production after receipt of first article approval.
quote: To minimize this risk, the contracting officer shall provide sufficient time in the delivery schedule for acquisition of materials and components, and for production after receipt of first article approval.

statement: The DPAS establishes two levels of priority for rated orders, identified by the rating symbols DO and DX.
quote: There are two levels of priority for rated orders established by the DPAS, identified by the rating symbols “DO” and “DX”.

statement: FAR 11.603(a) says the DPAS regulation contains provisions concerning the elements of a rated order, acceptance and rejection of rated orders, preferential scheduling and extension of priority ratings (flowdown).
quote: The DPAS regulation contains provisions concerning the elements of a rated order (see 15 CFR 700.12); acceptance and rejection of rated orders (see 15 CFR 700.13); preferential scheduling (see 15 CFR 700.14); extension of priority ratings (flowdown) (see 15 CFR 700.15);

statement: If a rated order is placed for the purpose of emergency preparedness requirements, expedited action is necessary or appropriate to meet these requirements and the order includes the statement set forth in section 700.12(b), a person must accept or reject the rated order.
quote: If a rated order is placed for the purpose of emergency preparedness requirements and expedited action is necessary or appropriate to meet these requirements and the order includes the statement set forth in § 700.12(b), a person must accept or reject the rated order
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.13(d)(2).

statement: A person must schedule operations, including the acquisition of all needed production items, in a timely manner to satisfy the delivery requirements of each rated order.
quote: A person must schedule operations, including the acquisition of all needed production items, in a timely manner to satisfy the delivery requirements of each rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.14(a).

statement: 15 CFR 700.15(b) states that the inclusion of the rating will continue from contractor to subcontractor to supplier throughout the entire supply chain.
quote: Therefore, the inclusion of the rating will continue from contractor to subcontractor to supplier throughout the entire supply chain.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.15(b).

statement: A person must use rated orders with suppliers to obtain industrial resources needed to fill a rated order.
quote: A person must use rated orders with suppliers to obtain industrial resources needed to fill a rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.15(a).

statement: Solicitations containing a testing and approval requirement shall carry out the items listed in FAR 9.306.
quote: Solicitations containing a testing and approval requirement shall—

statement: DFARS 217.172(b) provides that the head of the agency may enter into a multiyear contract for supplies if, in addition to the conditions listed in FAR 17.105-1(b), the use of such a contract will promote the national security of the United States.
quote: The head of the agency may enter into a multiyear contract for supplies if, in addition to the conditions listed in FAR 17.105-1(b), the use of such a contract will promote the national security of the United States

statement: The statement prescribed for certain emergency preparedness rated orders says the order must be accepted or rejected within a time limit no less than the minimum applicable time limit specified in the acceptance and rejection section.
quote: It must be accepted or rejected within [Insert a time limit no less than the minimum applicable time limit specified in § 700.13(d)(2)].
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.12(b).

statement: The Department of Commerce has authorized the Delegate Agencies to assign priority ratings to orders for industrial resources needed for use in approved programs.
quote: (b) Delegations by the Department of Commerce. The Department of Commerce has authorized the Delegate Agencies to assign priority ratings to orders for industrial resources needed for use in approved programs.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.10(b).

statement: Unless otherwise agreed to by the concerned agencies, the part is not applicable to listed categories, one of which is food resources, food resource facilities, livestock resources, veterinary resources, plant health resources and the domestic distribution of farm equipment and commercial fertilizer.
quote: Unless otherwise agreed to by the concerned agencies, the provisions of this part are not applicable to: (i) Food resources, food resource facilities, livestock resources, veterinary resources, plant health resources, and the domestic distribution of farm equipment and commercial fertilizer
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.10(c)(1)(i); the section lists further excluded categories.

statement: The regulation establishes two levels of priority, identified by the rating symbols DO and DX.
quote: (1) There are two levels of priority established by this regulation, identified by the rating symbols “DO” and “DX.”
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.11(a)(1).

statement: All DO rated orders have equal priority with each other and take preference over unrated orders, and all DX rated orders have equal priority with each other and take preference over DO rated orders and unrated orders.
quote: (2) All DO rated orders have equal priority with each other and take preference over unrated orders. All DX rated orders have equal priority with each other and take preference over DO rated orders and unrated orders.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.11(a)(2).

statement: A Directive issued by Commerce takes preference over any DX rated order, DO rated order or unrated order, as stipulated in the Directive.
quote: (3) In addition, a Directive issued by Commerce takes preference over any DX rated order, DO rated order, or unrated order, as stipulated in the Directive.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.11(a)(3).

statement: Program identification symbols do not in themselves connote any priority, and a priority rating consists of the rating symbol, DO or DX, and the program identification symbol.
quote: Program identification symbols, in themselves, do not connote any priority. (c) Priority ratings. A priority rating consists of the rating symbol—DO and DX—and the program identification symbol, such as A1, A7, or N1.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.11(b) and (c).

statement: The priority rating on a rated order may be changed or cancelled by an official action of the Department of Commerce or by written notification from the person who placed the rated order, including a Delegate Agency.
quote: (a) The priority rating on a rated order may be changed or cancelled by: (1) An official action of the Department of Commerce; or (2) Written notification from the person who placed the rated order (including a Delegate Agency).
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.16(a).

statement: An amendment to a rated order that significantly alters a supplier's original production or delivery schedule constitutes a new rated order as of the date of its receipt, and the supplier must accept or reject the amended order.
quote: (c) An amendment to a rated order that significantly alters a supplier's original production or delivery schedule shall constitute a new rated order as of the date of its receipt. The supplier must accept or reject the amended order according to the provisions of § 700.13.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.16(c).

statement: A person must cancel any rated orders that the person or a predecessor in interest has placed with suppliers, or cancel the priority ratings on those orders, if the person no longer needs the items in those orders to fill a rated order.
quote: (e) A person must cancel any rated orders that the person (or a predecessor in interest) has placed with suppliers or cancel the priority ratings on those orders if the person no longer needs the items in those orders to fill a rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.16(e).

statement: Among the things a person must use rated orders to obtain are items that will be physically incorporated into other items to fill rated orders, including the portion of such items normally consumed or converted into scrap or by-products in the course of processing.
quote: (a) A person must use rated orders to obtain: (1) Items which will be physically incorporated into other items to fill rated orders, including that portion of such items normally consumed, or converted into scrap or by-products, in the course of processing;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.17(a)(1).

statement: One listed thing a person must use rated orders to obtain is MRO needed to produce the finished items to fill rated orders, and the priority rating used for MRO must contain the program identification symbol H7 along with the rating symbol on the customer's rated order.
quote: (4) MRO needed to produce the finished items to fill rated orders. However, for MRO, the priority rating used must contain the program identification symbol H7 along with the rating symbol contained on the customer's rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.17(a)(4); the printed sections do not define MRO.

statement: A person may use a rated order to replace inventoried items, including finished items, that were used to fill rated orders, and one listed condition is that the order be placed within 90 days of the date of use of the inventory.
quote: (b) A person may use a rated order to replace inventoried items (including finished items) if such items were used to fill rated orders, as follows: (1) The order must be placed within ninety (90) days of the date of use of the inventory.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.17(b)(1).

statement: One listed condition for a rated order that replaces inventoried items is that it use a DO rating symbol and the program identification symbol on the customer's rated order, and a DX rating symbol may not be used even if the inventory was used to fill a DX rated order.
quote: (2) A DO rating symbol and the program identification symbol indicated on the customer's rated order must be used on the order. A DX rating symbol may not be used even if the inventory was used to fill a DX rated order.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.17(b)(2).

statement: A person may not place a rated order unless the person is in receipt of a rated order, has been explicitly authorized to do so by the Department of Commerce or a Delegate Agency, or is otherwise permitted to do so by the part.
quote: (a) General limitations. (1) A person may not place a rated order pursuant to this part unless the person is in receipt of a rated order, has been explicitly authorized to do so by the Department of Commerce or a Delegate Agency or is otherwise permitted to do so by this part.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(a)(1).

statement: Rated orders may not be used to obtain delivery on a date earlier than needed, or a greater quantity of the item than needed except to obtain a minimum procurable quantity.
quote: (2) Rated orders may not be used to obtain: (i) Delivery on a date earlier than needed; (ii) A greater quantity of the item than needed, except to obtain a minimum procurable quantity;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(a)(2)(i) and (ii); the list continues in the same paragraph.

statement: One listed thing rated orders may not be used to obtain is items in advance of the receipt of a rated order, except as specifically authorized by the Department of Commerce.
quote: (iii) Items in advance of the receipt of a rated order, except as specifically authorized by the Department of Commerce (see § 700.51(c) for information on obtaining authorization for a priority rating in advance of a rated order);
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(a)(2)(iii); the quote points to § 700.51(c), which is not printed here.

statement: One listed group of items for which rated orders may not be used, unless specific priority rating authority has been obtained from a Delegate Agency or the Department of Commerce, is items for plant improvement, expansion or construction, unless they will be physically incorporated into a construction project covered by a rated order.
quote: Any of the following items unless specific priority rating authority has been obtained from a Delegate Agency or the Department of Commerce: (A) Items for plant improvement, expansion, or construction, unless they will be physically incorporated into a construction project covered by a rated order;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(a)(2)(iv)(A).

statement: One listed item is production or construction equipment or items to be used for the manufacture of production equipment.
quote: (B) Production or construction equipment or items to be used for the manufacture of production equipment
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(a)(2)(iv)(B); it sits in the same list as the preceding claim.

statement: Notwithstanding any authorization or requirement elsewhere in the part, no person may place a rated order to obtain listed items, one of which is copper raw materials, unless such order is authorized by an official action of the Department of Commerce.
quote: Notwithstanding any authorization or requirement to place a rated order stated elsewhere in this part, no person may place a rated order to obtain the following items unless such order is authorized by an official action of the Department of Commerce. (1) Copper raw materials.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.18(b); the list continues with other items.

statement: For projects believed to maximize domestic energy supplies, a person may request priority rating authority for scarce, critical and essential supplies of materials, equipment and services.
quote: (a) For projects believed to maximize domestic energy supplies, a person may request priority rating authority for scarce, critical, and essential supplies of materials, equipment, and services
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.21(a).

statement: A person may request priority rating authority for scarce, critical and essential supplies of materials, equipment and services (related to the production of materials or equipment, or the installation, repair or maintenance of equipment) by submitting a request to the Department of Energy.
quote: a person may request priority rating authority for scarce, critical, and essential supplies of materials, equipment, and services (related to the production of materials or equipment, or the installation, repair, or maintenance of equipment) by submitting a request to the Department of Energy.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.21(a); the first part of the sentence is claim CL-IND-0182.

statement: If the Department of Energy notifies the Department of Commerce that the project maximizes domestic energy supplies and that the materials, equipment or services are critical and essential, the Department of Commerce will determine whether the items in question are scarce.
quote: (b) If the Department of Energy notifies the Department of Commerce that the project maximizes domestic energy supplies and that the materials, equipment, or services are critical and essential, the Department of Commerce will determine whether the items in question are scarce
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.21(b); the sentence goes on to a second finding about need to use the priorities authority.

statement: After its analysis, the Department of Commerce will advise the Department of Energy whether the two findings have been satisfied, and if they are satisfied it will authorize the Department of Energy to grant the use of a priority rating to the applicant.
quote: After the Department of Commerce has conducted its analysis, it will advise the Department of Energy whether the two findings have been satisfied. If the findings are satisfied, the Department of Commerce will authorize the Department of Energy to grant the use of a priority rating to the applicant.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.21(c).

statement: Before using its allocations authority to address a supply problem within its resource jurisdiction, the Department of Commerce will develop a plan with listed contents.
quote: Before the Department of Commerce uses its allocations authority to address a supply problem within its resource jurisdiction, it will develop a plan that includes:
note: Source is the lead-in of 15 CFR 700.31.

statement: Three listed contents of the plan are a statement of the specific objectives of the allocation action, a list of the materials, services or facilities to be allocated, and a list or description of the sources subject to the action.
quote: (c) A statement of the specific objective(s) of the allocation action; (d) A list of the materials, services, or facilities to be allocated; (e) A list or description of the sources of the materials, services, or facilities that will be subject to the allocation action;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.31(c) to (e).

statement: Allocation orders may be issued directly to the affected persons, by constructive notice through publication in the Federal Register, or by publication of a temporary final rule in the Federal Register.
quote: Allocation orders may be issued directly to the affected persons, by constructive notice to the parties through publication in the Federal Register, or by the publication of a temporary final rule in the Federal Register.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.34, opening sentence.

statement: Every allocation order must include a detailed description of the required allocation action, including its relationship to previously or subsequently received DX rated orders, DO rated orders and unrated orders.
quote: Elements to be included in all allocation orders. (1) A detailed description of the required allocation action(s), including its relationship to previously or subsequently received DX rated orders, DO rated orders, and unrated orders.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.34(a)(1).

statement: One listed element of every allocation order is specific start and end calendar dates for each required allocation action.
quote: (2) Specific start and end calendar dates for each required allocation action.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.34(a)(2).

statement: An allocation order issued directly to affected persons must include a statement that reads in substance that it is an allocation order certified for national defense use.
quote: (b) Elements to be included in orders issued directly to affected persons. (1) A statement that reads in substance: “This is an allocation order certified for national defense use.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.34(b)(1).

statement: The printed section 700.34 was revised, effective August 27, 2026, through August 27, 2027.
quote: Effective Date Note: At 91 FR 50705, Aug. 6, 2026, § 700.34 was revised, effective Aug. 27, 2026, through Aug. 27, 2027.
note: Source is the effective date note after 15 CFR 700.34.

statement: Audits and investigations are official actions involving the examination of books, records, documents, other writings and information to ensure that the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act and related statutes, and the part have been properly followed.
quote: (a) Audits and investigations are official actions involving the examination of books, records, documents, other writings, and information to ensure that the provisions of the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act and related statutes, and this part have been properly followed.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.71(a).

statement: The Department of Commerce may issue administrative subpoenas, which constitute official actions.
quote: (c) In administering this part, the Department of Commerce may issue the following documents, which constitute official actions: (1) Administrative subpoenas.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.71(c)(1); the section describes the subpoena further.

statement: One listed document, a demand for information, requires a person to furnish to a duly authorized representative of the Department of Commerce any information necessary or appropriate to the enforcement or the administration of the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act or the part.
quote: Demand for information. A demand for information requires a person to furnish to a duly authorized representative of the Department of Commerce any information necessary or appropriate to the enforcement or the administration of the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act, or this part.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.71(c)(2).

statement: Willful violation of the listed provisions of the Defense Production Act, the priorities provisions of the Selective Service Act and related statutes, or the part is a crime, and upon conviction a person may be punished by fine or imprisonment, or both.
quote: (a) Willful violation of the provisions of Title I or sections 705 or 707 of the Defense Production Act, the priorities provisions of the Selective Service Act and related statutes or this part is a crime and upon conviction, a person may be punished by fine or imprisonment, or both
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.74(a).

statement: The government may also seek an injunction from a court of appropriate jurisdiction to prohibit the continuance of any violation of, or to enforce compliance with, the Defense Production Act, the part, or an official action.
quote: (b) The government may also seek an injunction from a court of appropriate jurisdiction to prohibit the continuance of any violation of, or to enforce compliance with, the Defense Production Act, this part, or an official action.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.74(b).

statement: The adjustments or exceptions process applies to the part and to official actions issued under it, except for Directive Allocation Orders issued by a temporary final rule.
quote: The adjustments or exceptions described in this section apply to this part and official actions issued under this part, except for Directive Allocation Orders issued by a temporary final rule.
note: Source is the opening of 15 CFR 700.80.

statement: A person may submit a request to the Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security of the Department of Commerce for an adjustment or exception on listed grounds.
quote: (a) A person may submit a request to the Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security, U.S. Department of Commerce, for an adjustment or exception on the ground that:
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.80(a), lead-in.

statement: One listed ground for an adjustment or exception is that a provision of the part or an official action results in an undue or exceptional hardship on that person not suffered generally by others in similar situations and circumstances.
quote: (1) A provision of this part or an official action results in an undue or exceptional hardship on that person not suffered generally by others in similar situations and circumstances;
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.80(a)(1).

statement: One listed ground for an adjustment or exception is that the consequence of following a provision of the part or an official action is contrary to the intent of the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act and related statutes, or the part.
quote: (2) The consequence of following a provision of this part or an official action is contrary to the intent of the Defense Production Act, the Selective Service Act and related statutes, or this part.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.80(a)(2).

statement: The Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security shall respond to requests for adjustment of or exceptions to compliance within 25 days, not including Saturdays, Sundays or Government holidays, of the date of receipt.
quote: The Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security shall respond to requests for adjustment of or exceptions to compliance with the provisions of this part or an official action within twenty-five (25) days, not including Saturdays, Sundays or Government holidays, of the date of receipt.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.80(c).

statement: A request for adjustment or exception does not relieve any person from complying with the part or official action in question while the request is being considered, unless such interim relief is granted in writing.
quote: The submission of a request for adjustment or exception shall not relieve any person from the obligation of complying with the provisions of this part or official action in question while the request is being considered unless such interim relief is granted in writing
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.80(c), first sentence.

statement: A person whose request for adjustment or exception has been denied by the Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security may appeal to the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration, who shall review and reconsider the denial.
quote: Any person who has had a request for adjustment or exception denied by the Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security under § 700.80, may appeal to the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration, Department of Commerce, who shall review and reconsider the denial.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.81(a).

statement: An appeal of a denied request must be received by the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration no later than 45 days after receipt of a written notice of denial.
quote: Appeals of denied requests for exceptions from or adjustments to compliance with the provisions of this part or an official action must be received by the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration no later than forty-five (45) days after receipt of a written notice of denial
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.81(b); the next sentence of the section lets the Assistant Secretary accept a later appeal at discretion.

statement: The decision of the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration shall be made within a reasonable time after receipt of the appeal and shall be the final administrative action.
quote: (h) The decision of the Assistant Secretary for Export Administration shall be made within a reasonable time after receipt of the appeal and shall be the final administrative action.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.81(h).

statement: The printed section 700.80 was amended, effective August 27, 2026, through August 27, 2027.
quote: Effective Date Note: At 91 FR 50705, Aug. 6, 2026, § 700.80 was amended, effective Aug. 27, 2026, through Aug. 27, 2027.
note: Source is the effective date note after 15 CFR 700.80.

statement: Persons are required to make and preserve for at least three years accurate and complete records of any transaction covered by the part or an official action.
quote: (a) Persons are required to make and preserve for at least three years, accurate and complete records of any transaction covered by this part (OMB control number 0694-0053) or an official action.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.91(a).

statement: Records must be maintained in sufficient detail to permit the determination, upon examination, of whether each transaction complies with the part or any official action, and the part does not specify any particular method or system to be used.
quote: (b) Records must be maintained in sufficient detail to permit the determination, upon examination, of whether each transaction complies with the provisions of this part or any official action. However, this part does not specify any particular method or system to be used.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.91(b).

statement: Records required to be maintained by the part must be made available for examination on demand by duly authorized representatives of the Department of Commerce.
quote: (c) Records required to be maintained by this part must be made available for examination on demand by duly authorized representatives of the Department of Commerce as provided in § 700.71.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.91(c).

statement: The part and all official actions, unless specifically stated otherwise, apply to transactions in any state, territory or possession of the United States and the District of Columbia.
quote: (a) This part and all official actions, unless specifically stated otherwise, apply to transactions in any state, territory, or possession of the United States and the District of Columbia.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.92(a).

statement: The part and all official actions apply not only to deliveries to other persons but also to deliveries to affiliates and subsidiaries of a person and deliveries from one branch, division or section of a single entity to another under common ownership or control.
quote: This part and all official actions apply not only to deliveries to other persons but also include deliveries to affiliates and subsidiaries of a person and deliveries from one branch, division, or section of a single entity to another branch, division, or section under common ownership or control.
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.92(b).

statement: The small-order level below which a person is not required to place a priority rating on an order is $125,000 or one half of the Simplified Acquisition Threshold, whichever amount is greater.
quote: A person is not required to place a priority rating on an order for less than $125,000, or one half of the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (as established in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)) (see FAR section 2.101), whichever amount is greater
note: Source is 15 CFR 700.17(f); the timely-delivery proviso is the next claim.

statement: The relief from placing a priority rating on a small order applies provided that delivery can be obtained in a timely fashion without the use of the priority rating.
quote: provided that delivery can be obtained in a timely fashion without the use of the priority rating.

statement: In determining whether affiliation exists, SBA considers the totality of the circumstances and may find affiliation even though no single factor is sufficient to constitute affiliation.
quote: In determining whether affiliation exists, SBA will consider the totality of the circumstances, and may find affiliation even though no single factor is sufficient to constitute affiliation.

quote: such minority holdings are equal or approximately equal in size, and the aggregate of these minority holdings is large as compared with any other stock holding, SBA presumes that each such person controls or has the power to control the concern whose size is at issue.

statement: A covered transaction is any of several listed items, the first two being a covered control transaction and a covered investment.
quote: The term covered transaction means any of the following: (a) A covered control transaction; (b) A covered investment;

quote: The term TID U.S. business means any U.S. business that: (a) Produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates, or develops one or more critical technologies;

statement: Except as provided in three listed paragraphs, the parties to a transaction described in the section's two trigger paragraphs must submit a declaration to the Committee.
quote: Except as provided in paragraph (d), (e), or (f) of this section, the parties to a transaction described in paragraph (b) or (c) of this section shall submit to the Committee a declaration with information regarding the transaction in accordance with § 800.403.

statement: A covered transaction that results in a foreign person acquiring a substantial interest in a TID U.S. business, where the governments of a single foreign state other than an excepted foreign state hold a substantial interest in that foreign person, is a mandatory declaration trigger.
quote: a covered transaction that results in the acquisition of a substantial interest in a TID U.S. business by a foreign person in which the national or subnational governments of a single foreign state (other than an excepted foreign state) have a substantial interest.

statement: A mandatory declaration trigger concerns a TID U.S. business that produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates or develops one or more critical technologies for which a U.S. regulatory authorization would be required for the export, reexport, transfer in-country or retransfer of that technology to a person described in the listed items.
quote: a TID U.S. business that produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates, or develops one or more critical technologies for which a U.S. regulatory authorization would be required for the export, reexport, transfer (in-country), or retransfer of such critical technology to a person that:

statement: A voting interest for critical technology mandatory declarations is a direct or indirect voting interest of 25 percent or more, subject to the section's rules for entities run by a general partner and for indirect holdings.
quote: The term voting interest for purposes of critical technology mandatory declarations means, for the purposes of § 800.401(c)(1)(v), a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 25 percent or more, subject to paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section.

statement: Parties must submit the required declaration, or a written notice in its place, no later than the dates that the paragraph lists next.
quote: (g) Parties shall submit to the Committee the declaration required under paragraph (a) of this section, or a written notice under paragraph (f) of this section, no later than:

quote: (2) Thirty days before the completion date of the transaction, if the completion date of the transaction is after March 14, 2020.

quote: (e) The submission of a declaration shall not be required under paragraph (c) of this section with respect to: (1) A covered control transaction by an excepted investor;

statement: A person who fails to comply with the mandatory declaration section may be liable to the United States for a civil penalty not to exceed $5,000,000 or the value of the transaction, whichever is greater.
quote: Any person who fails to comply with the requirements of § 800.401 may be liable to the United States for a civil penalty not to exceed $5,000,000 or the value of the transaction, whichever is greater.

statement: Except as otherwise prohibited under section 800.403(e), a party to any proposed or completed transaction may submit a declaration to the Committee instead of a written notice.
quote: Except as otherwise prohibited under § 800.403(e), a party to any proposed or completed transaction may submit to the Committee a declaration regarding the transaction in accordance with the procedures and requirements set forth in §§ 800.403 and 800.404 instead of a written notice.

statement: The 30-day assessment period for a declaration starts on the date the Committee receives the declaration from the Staff Chairperson.
quote: A 30-day period for assessment of a covered transaction that is the subject of a declaration shall commence on the date on which the declaration is received by the Committee from the Staff Chairperson.

statement: The 30-day assessment period for a declaration starts when the Committee receives the declaration from the Staff Chairperson and ends no later than the thirtieth day after it starts, or no later than the next business day if the thirtieth day is not a business day.
quote: shall commence on the date on which the declaration is received by the Committee from the Staff Chairperson. Such period shall end no later than the thirtieth day after it has commenced, or if the thirtieth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the thirtieth day.

statement: On receiving a declaration the Committee may, at its discretion, take the actions that the paragraph lists next.
quote: (a) Upon receiving a declaration submitted under § 800.403 with respect to a covered transaction, the Committee may, at the discretion of the Committee:

statement: One listed Committee response is to request that the parties file a written notice, if the Committee has reason to believe the transaction may raise national security considerations.
quote: the Committee may, at the discretion of the Committee: (1) If the Committee has reason to believe that the transaction may raise national security considerations, request that the parties to the transaction file a written notice under subpart E;

statement: One listed Committee response is to initiate a unilateral review of the transaction, and another is to notify the parties in writing that the Committee has concluded all action under section 721.
quote: (3) Initiate a unilateral review of the transaction under § 800.501(c); or (4) Notify the parties in writing that the Committee has concluded all action under section 721 with respect to the transaction.

statement: A 45-day review period starts on the date a voluntary notice has been accepted, an agency notice has been received by the Staff Chairperson, or the Chairperson has requested a notice.
quote: A 45-day period for review of a transaction shall commence on the date on which the voluntary notice has been accepted, agency notice has been received by the Staff Chairperson, or the Chairperson of the Committee has requested a notice under § 800.501(b).

statement: The review ends no later than the forty-fifth day after it commences, or the next business day if the forty-fifth day is not a business day.
quote: Such review shall end no later than the forty-fifth day after it has commenced, or if the forty-fifth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the forty-fifth day.

statement: After a review of a notified transaction, the Committee must undertake an investigation of any transaction it has determined to be a covered transaction if one of the listed conditions is met.
quote: (a) After a review of a notified transaction under § 800.503, the Committee shall undertake an investigation of any transaction that it has determined to be a covered transaction if:

statement: One listed condition is that a Committee member other than an ex officio member advises the Staff Chairperson that the member believes the transaction threatens to impair national security and that the threat has not been mitigated.
quote: (1) A member of the Committee (other than a member designated as ex officio under section 721(k)) advises the Staff Chairperson that the member believes that the transaction threatens to impair the national security of the United States and that the threat has not been mitigated; or

statement: One listed condition is that the lead agency recommends an investigation and the Committee concurs.
quote: (2) The lead agency recommends, and the Committee concurs, that an investigation be undertaken.

statement: After a review of a covered transaction, the Committee must also undertake an investigation to determine the effects on national security of any covered transaction that is a foreign government-controlled transaction.
quote: (b) The Committee shall also undertake, after a review of a covered transaction under § 800.503, an investigation to determine the effects on national security of any covered transaction that: (1) Is a foreign government-controlled transaction; or

statement: One listed item for the investigation is a covered transaction that would result in foreign-person control of critical infrastructure of or within the United States, if the Committee determines the transaction could impair national security and the impairment has not been mitigated.
quote: (2) Would result in control by a foreign person of critical infrastructure of or within the United States, if the Committee determines that the transaction could impair national security and such impairment has not been mitigated.

statement: The Committee must undertake the investigation described in paragraph (b) of the section unless the Chairperson of the Committee (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the head of any lead agency (or that head's deputy-level delegee) make a determination that the remainder of the sentence states.
quote: The Committee shall undertake an investigation as described in paragraph (b) of this section unless the Chairperson of the Committee (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the head of any lead agency (or his or her delegee at the deputy level or equivalent)

statement: The determination, made by the Chairperson (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the lead-agency head designated by the Chairperson, is that on the basis of the review the covered transaction will not impair the national security of the United States.
quote: (or his or her delegee at the deputy level or equivalent) designated by the Chairperson determine on the basis of the review that the covered transaction will not impair the national security of the United States.

statement: Subject to a paragraph on extension, the Committee must complete an investigation no later than the forty-fifth day after the date it commences, or the next business day if the forty-fifth day is not a business day.
quote: (a) Subject to paragraph (e) of this section, the Committee shall complete an investigation no later than the forty-fifth day after the date the investigation commences, or, if the forty-fifth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the forty-fifth day.

statement: On completion or termination of an investigation the Committee must send the President a report requesting the President's decision if a listed condition is met, one being that the Committee recommends that the President suspend or prohibit the transaction.
quote: (b) Upon completion or termination of any investigation, the Committee shall send a report to the President requesting the President's decision if: (1) The Committee recommends that the President suspend or prohibit the transaction;

statement: The extension rule for a request for additional information applies to a request to any person other than the person whose voting securities are acquired in a tender offer (or that person's officers and others) or the acquired person in an acquisition covered by 11 USC 363(b).
quote: any person other than either: (i) In the case of a tender offer, the person whose voting securities are being acquired pursuant to the tender offer (or any officer, director, partner, agent or employee thereof), or (ii) In the case of an acquisition covered by 11 U.S.C. 363(b), the acquired person,

statement: If a waiting period would expire on a Saturday, Sunday or legal public holiday, it is extended to the end of the next regular business day, Eastern Time.
quote: (3) If any waiting period would expire on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal public holiday (as defined in 5 U.S.C. 6103(a)) the waiting period shall be extended to 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time of the next regular business day.

statement: If either person's notification expires under the eighteen-month paragraph, both parties must file a new notification in order to carry out the transaction.
quote: If either person's notification expires pursuant to this paragraph, both parties must file a new notification in order to carry out the transaction.

statement: An acquiring person whose notification was voluntarily withdrawn, or is deemed to have been automatically withdrawn, may resubmit its notification.
quote: An acquiring person whose notification has been voluntarily withdrawn pursuant to paragraph (a) of this section, or an acquiring person whose notification is deemed to have been automatically withdrawn under paragraph (b) of this section, may resubmit its notification

quote: (i) The notification is withdrawn prior to the expiration or early termination of the waiting period and prior to the issuance of a request for additional information pursuant to § 803.20 and section 7A(e) of the act;

statement: A covered control transaction is any transaction proposed or pending after a stated date by or with a foreign person that could result in foreign control of any U.S. business, including one carried out through a joint venture.
quote: The term covered control transaction means any transaction that is proposed or pending after August 23, 1988, by or with any foreign person that could result in foreign control of any U.S. business, including such a transaction carried out through a joint venture.

statement: An excepted investor is a foreign person who is, as of the completion date of the transaction and subject to two later paragraphs of the section, within a list of categories that follows.
quote: The term excepted investor means a foreign person who is, as of the completion date of the transaction and subject to paragraphs (c) and (d) of this section:

statement: Critical technologies means a list of items that begins with defense articles or defense services included on the United States Munitions List.
quote: The term critical technologies means the following: (a) Defense articles or defense services included on the United States Munitions List (USML) set forth in the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130);

statement: A foreign government-controlled transaction is any covered control transaction that could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign government or a person controlled by or acting on behalf of a foreign government.
quote: The term foreign government-controlled transaction means any covered control transaction that could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign government or a person controlled by or acting on behalf of a foreign government.

statement: In the context of an acquisition of an interest in a U.S. business by a foreign person, a substantial interest is a direct or indirect voting interest of 25 percent or more.
quote: The term substantial interest means, in the context of an acquisition of an interest in a U.S. business by a foreign person, a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 25 percent or more,

quote: and, in the context of a foreign person in which the national or subnational governments of a single foreign state have an interest, subject to paragraph (b) of this section, a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 49 percent or more.

statement: Critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered control transaction, systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, so vital to the United States that their incapacity or destruction would have a debilitating impact on national security.
quote: The term critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered control transaction, systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, so vital to the United States that the incapacity or destruction of such systems or assets would have a debilitating impact on national security.

statement: Covered investment critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered investment, the systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, set forth in column 1 of appendix A to the part.
quote: The term covered investment critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered investment, the systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, set forth in column 1 of appendix A to this part.

statement: Two listed persons for the critical-technology trigger are a person that could directly control the TID U.S. business as a result of the covered transaction and a person directly acquiring an interest that is a covered investment in it.
quote: (i) Could directly control such TID U.S. business as a result of the covered transaction; (ii) Is directly acquiring an interest that is a covered investment in such TID U.S. business;

quote: (f) Notwithstanding paragraph (a) of this section, parties to a covered transaction may elect to submit a written notice under subpart E of this part regarding the transaction instead of a declaration.

statement: The Committee must take action on a declaration within the time period that section 800.405(b) sets.
quote: (b) The Committee shall take action under paragraph (a) of this section within the time period set forth in § 800.405(b).

statement: In extraordinary circumstances the Chairperson may, on a written request signed by the head of a lead agency, extend an investigation for one 15-day period.
quote: (e) In extraordinary circumstances, the Chairperson may, upon a written request signed by the head of a lead agency, extend an investigation for one 15-day period.

statement: An investigation that is to be undertaken commences no later than the end of the review period.
quote: If it is determined that an investigation should be undertaken, such investigation shall commence no later than the end of the review period described in § 800.503.

quote: (3) For purposes of paragraph (c)(1) of this section, the assessment of what constitutes a critical technology shall be as of the first date on which one of the conditions set forth in § 800.104(b)(1) through (4) is met with respect to a covered transaction.

statement: An acquiring person's notification, and an acquired person's notification in an acquisition to which section 801.30 does not apply, expires eighteen months after the date of receipt of that person's notification in the circumstances the paragraph describes.
quote: An acquiring person's notification and, in the case of an acquisition to which § 801.30 does not apply, an acquired person's notification, shall expire eighteen months following the date of receipt of such person's notification

quote: This section does not apply to a real estate operation subject to § 210.3-14 or a business which is totally held by the registrant prior to consummation of the transaction.

quote: In all cases not specified in paragraph (b)(1) of this section, financial statements of the business acquired or to be acquired must be filed for the periods specified in this paragraph (b)(2) or such shorter period as the business has been in existence.

quote: Separate financial statements of the acquired business specified in paragraph (b)(2)(ii) of this section need not be presented once the operating results of the acquired business have been reflected in the audited consolidated financial statements of the registrant for at least nine months.

statement: Separate statements of the acquired business at the highest significance band need not be presented once its operating results have been reflected in the registrant's audited consolidated statements for a complete fiscal year.

statement: Pro forma financial information must be filed when any of the listed conditions exists.

quote: (1) During the most recent fiscal year or subsequent interim period for which a balance sheet is required by § 210.3-01, a significant business acquisition has occurred (for purposes of this section, this encompasses the acquisition of an interest in a business accounted for by the equity method);

quote: (2) After the date of the most recent balance sheet filed pursuant to § 210.3-01, consummation of a significant business acquisition or a combination of entities under common control has occurred or is probable;

statement: One listed condition is that securities being registered are to be offered to the security holders of a significant business to be acquired, or that the proceeds will be applied directly or indirectly to the purchase of a specific significant business.

statement: Pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income must be filed for only the most recent fiscal year, except as noted in a later paragraph of the same section, and for the period from the most recent fiscal year end to the most recent interim date for which a balance sheet is required.

statement: The section opened for this topic is the guide's organization guideline on defining the work breakdown structure, labelled in the source as an EIA standard guideline.

note: The printed source is page text from the DoD EVMS Interpretation Guide, so no codified or RFO citation is recorded for it.

statement: The guideline requires the contractor to define the authorized work elements for the program, and records that a product-oriented work breakdown structure tailored for effective internal management control is commonly used for that purpose.
quote: Define the authorized work elements for the program. A product-oriented work breakdown structure, tailored for effective internal management control, is commonly used in this process.

statement: The work breakdown structure is a product-oriented, hierarchical breakdown of the program requirements that includes all program elements, such as hardware, software, services, data or facilities.
quote: The WBS is a product-oriented, hierarchical breakdown of the program requirements. The WBS includes all program elements (e.g., hardware, software, services, data, or facilities)

statement: The work breakdown structure must also include all subcontracted work scope.
quote: The WBS must also include all subcontracted work scope.

statement: The contractor must extend the contract work breakdown structure to a level needed for effective internal management control, and this level should not be an arbitrary level established across the program.
quote: In all cases, the contractor must extend the contract WBS to a level needed for effective internal management control. This should not be an arbitrary level established across the program.

statement: Cost collection requirements, such as cost and software data reporting, may require a different reporting structure than the work breakdown structure used in the earned value management system for program management.
quote: Cost collection requirements, such as Cost and Software Data Reporting (CSDR), may require a different reporting structure other than the WBS used in the Earned Value Management System (EVMS)

statement: A single product-oriented work breakdown structure is used for a given contract and extends to the level necessary for management action, comprising all contract work scope including subcontracted and intercompany scope.
quote: A single product-oriented WBS is used for a given contract and extends to the level necessary for management action. The WBS comprises all contract work scope, including subcontracted and intercompany scope, to levels needed for effective internal management control.

statement: The section opened for this topic is the guide's organization guideline on defining the program organizational breakdown structure, labelled in the source as an EIA standard guideline.

quote: Identify the program organizational structure, including the major subcontractors, responsible for accomplishing the authorized work and define the organizational elements where work will be planned and controlled.

statement: The hierarchical alpha-numeric unique coding of the organization structure results in the organizational breakdown structure.
quote: The hierarchical alpha-numeric unique coding of the organization structure results in the Organizational Breakdown Structure (OBS).
